name: Load a pallet
description: From its base position, the station loads one pallet on Start: it pushes the pallet out of the magazine, runs it to the stop, sets each carton that comes along the belt onto it, two layers of four, and runs the full pallet to the end of the conveyor, where it waits to be taken away. The example program does this.

steps.line: The start lamp asks for Start
The station is in its base position
A pallet comes out of the magazine onto the conveyor
The pallet runs to the stop
The gantry takes the carton off the belt
Eight cartons on the pallet, in two layers
The full pallet runs to the end of the conveyor
The start lamp asks for Start again
